task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the open gripper over the table toward the blue cream cheese block.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the blue cream cheese block.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Open the gripper and readjust above the blue cream cheese block.
Open the gripper and readjust above the blue cream cheese box.
Lower the cream cheese down toward the table surface beside the bowl.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table and lift it upward.
Lift the blue cream cheese block up off the table, moving it toward the bowl.
Lower the blue cream cheese block down into the bowl.
Release the blue cream cheese block into the bowl.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and retract the empty gripper upward.
Hold the open gripper stationary above the bowl containing the blue cream cheese.
